programme.title: NASCAR: Race in Joliet

Chicagoland Speedway has hosted the series' playoff rounds over the years, and the wide surface and progressive bank angles encourage multiple race lines

programme.title: Tennis: Wimbledon Tournament – ​​women's doubles final match

programme.title: Women's volleyball: Nations League. USA – Brazil

programme.title: Women's volleyball: Nations League. Bulgaria – Germany
programme.desc: The Bulgarian representatives will face the Germans in the fourth match of the tournament in Belgrade. The competition in Serbia started differently for both teams - Germany won against the Czechs (3:1), while the Bulgarians lost to the Serbs (0:3). The last direct meeting of these teams took place in the Nations League in 2024. Then the Germans turned out to be better (3:1)

programme.title: Women's volleyball: Nations League. China – Italy
programme.desc: As hosts of the final tournament in Macau, the Chinese representatives do not have to worry about whether they will play in it. However, in the match against the Italians they will play to win. Firstly, they want to successfully complete the intercontinental phase of the Nations League, and secondly... winning against the currently best team in the world always tastes delicious and gives wind in the sails.

programme.title: Women's volleyball: Nations League. Belgium – Ukraine
programme.desc: Losing 2-3 to the Dominican Republic, the Ukrainian representatives did not improve their situation in the Nations League table. Our eastern neighbors occupy the lower parts of the ranking, and ahead of them is a clash with solid Belgium

programme.title: Tennis: Wimbledon Tournament – ​​men's singles final match
programme.desc: In the previous edition of the tournament, Jannik Sinner faced Carlos Alcaraz in the men's singles final and defeated him 3:1. Italy started this year's competition with a demanding fight against Miomir Kecmanovic, which he won 3-2, and in the next round he defeated Nuno Borges (3-0). The Wimbledon winner will receive £3.6 million and 2,000 ranking points

programme.title: Tennis: Wimbledon Tournament – ​​women's singles final match: Karolína Muchová – Linda Nosková
programme.desc: Czech fans can already celebrate because their compatriots will fight for the triumph at Wimbledon. Both tennis players did not have an easy path to the grand final. Karolina Muchova defeated Coco Gauff in three sets, while Linda Noskova eliminated Marta Kostiuk (2:0). The winner of this match will receive £3.6 million and her ranking account will be credited with 2,000 points.

programme.title: Football: 2026 World Cup – quarter-final match: Norway – England
programme.desc: The Norwegians have already deserved to be called the dark horse of the American World Cup. In the knockout phase, they first eliminated Senegal from the tournament (2:1), and then made a surprise by eliminating Brazil (2:1) with Vinicius Junior at the helm. Now the English are standing in the way of the Stale Solbakken team, having had difficult experiences in both the round of 16 (DR Congo 2:1) and the round of 16 (Mexico 3:2). The highlight of the match at Miami Stadium should be a duel between super snipers - Erling Haaland and Harry Kane. The former has already scored seven goals during the World Cup, the latter has six goals

programme.title: World Cup morning | E32
programme.desc: The World Championships held in North America may be a challenge for Polish fans, as some of the matches will take place at night. W. football magazine

programme.title: Football: 2026 World Cup – quarter-final match: France – Morocco
programme.desc: The quarterfinals will feature the teams that fought each other four years ago to advance to the final. The French won 2-0. Now the Tricolors are favorites again. Although in the 1/16 finals Kylian Mbappe and his teammates won only 1-0 against Paraguay, in this match they fought more to avoid getting seriously injured than to increase the score. Morocco defeated Canada 3-0

programme.title: Football: 2026 World Cup – quarter-final match: Spain – Belgium
programme.desc: The European champions reached the quarter-finals of the World Cup without conceding a single goal along the way. Much of this is due to Unai Simon, who became the longest undefeated goalkeeper in the history of the World Cup. In the round of 16 match, Lamine Yamal and company ended not only Portugal's adventure in the World Cup, but also Cristiano Ronaldo's World Cup history. The Spaniards will face the Belgians. After reversing the fate of the match against Senegal (3-2) in the round of 16, the Red Devils gained momentum and defeated the co-hosts of the world championship, the Americans, 4-1 in the previous round. Will they find a way to dismantle La Furia Roja's iron defense in the quarterfinals? Their task will be made more difficult by the absence of Amadou Onana, who suffered a serious injury in the previous match

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – quarter-final match: Argentina – Switzerland
programme.desc: Argentina has already received two serious warnings in the knockout phase. In the 1/16 finals, the Cape Verdean players were surprised twice, which sensationally led to overtime against the defending champions. However, in the 1/8 finals, Leo Messi and his teammates were out of the World Cup until the 83rd minute. Against Egypt, they had a brilliant end to the match, scoring three goals. They will face Switzerland in the match to advance to the top four. The Helvetii defeated the Colombian team in the 1/8 finals only after a penalty shootout

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Górnik Zabrze – Motor Lublin
programme.desc: Górnik Zabrze, the runner-up in the PKO BP Ekstraklasa after six rounds, will face Motor Lublin. The team led by Michal Gasparik is in great shape - it won the last two matches, against GKS Katowice and Pogoń Szczecin, both 3-0. After winning the first round against Arka Gdynia (1-0), Motor recorded two draws and two losses in the next four matches, and recently lost to Korona Kielce 0-2

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lech Poznań – Widzew Łódź
programme.desc: After losing to KRC Genk in two matches and being eliminated from the Europa League, the Polish champion returns to the Ekstraklasa competition. He played his last match at home over two weeks ago. On August 16, the team drew 1-1 with Korona Kielce. In the seventh round, Lech will host Widzew, ninth in the table, at home. The Łódź team will be led by Patryk Czubak, who replaced Zeljek Sopic as coach

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa – introduction to the match
Football: Ekstraklasa: Pogoń Szczecin – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: Marek Papszun's players did not start the new PKO BP Ekstraklasa season well. After four matches, they have only six points, with two wins and two losses. In the previous round, Raków Częstochowa defeated Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza 3:2. Now it will face Pogoń Szczecin, which has seven points after six rounds and won against Widzew Łódź 2-1 in the last series of games.

programme.title: Liga+
programme.desc: Rafał Dębiński, together with an invited expert, presents the events of each round of Ekstraklasa football matches. The program starts right after the end of the last of Saturday's matches. During it, direct connections are made to each stadium, where reporters present on site talk about the course of a given match, present extensive highlights and behind-the-scenes of the matches... football magazine

programme.title: Hero from the Shadow – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza | E02
programme.desc: The series presents the profiles of people working behind the scenes of Polish football clubs. They perform very important duties necessary for the functioning of the team, which are often invisible to outsiders. Krzysztof Kozik has been the manager of the first team of Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza for 20 years. He has been a resident of Nieciecza since birth. In the 1980s, he reactivated the LZS Nieciecza football club, which is an Ekstraklasa newcomer in the 2025/26 season. Kozik, known as Kiero, was also an active player and scored 245 goals for the team in the lower leagues. Poland. documentary series

programme.desc: Legia Warszawa players have not been able to take all points from the Cracovia stadium for years. For the last time, the Military defeated Pasy at ul. Puddle in 2020. We will see whether Edward Iordanescu's players, who believe in winning the national championship, will break this disastrous series.

Now the world's third racket will try to stop the current ranking leader from winning her first title in Indian Wells

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Merida – singles final match: Cristina Bucsa – Magdalena Fręch
programme.desc: Mexico favors Magdalena Fręch. The Pole won her first WTA tournament in her career in Mexico in 2024. Now in Merida he has a chance for a second triumph. Cristina Bucsa wants to stop her. Our tennis player last faced the Spanish in Landisville in 2021. Fręch was victorious in this clash, winning 6:2, 6:3

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Doha – singles final match: Karolína Muchová – Victoria Mboko
programme.desc: It's time to crown a new champion of the Doha tournament. It remains to be seen who will join the group of winners of this event, which includes, among others: Iga Świątek or Aryna Sabalenka. The winner of the competition will be richer by over PLN 665,000. dollars, and her account in the WTA ranking will be credited with 1,000 points

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Abu Dhabi - singles final match: Sara Bejlek - Ekaterina Aleksandrova
programme.desc: It's time to crown the new champion of the Abu Dhabi tournament. programme.desc: A series recalling amazing stories related to the Champions League. programme.desc: The Legionnaires and Lechites combine the game on several fronts with varying luck. The resulting marathon of meetings takes its toll on them. programme.desc: The Goats haven't had a good run lately. The lack of a win in seven matches in a row made Jakub Kamiński and his colleagues face the specter of relegation to the 2nd Bundesliga. Le Racing has no intention of giving up on the runner-up. He is still in the game for European cups and a victory in this match would allow him to be level on points with Rennes and Lille

programme.title: Football: Serie A. US Sassuolo Calcio – Hellas Verona
programme.desc: Hellas, which is closing the Serie A table, is already nine points behind the first place, which guarantees staying in the elite. To give themselves any hope of escaping the rope, the Gialloblu must do everything to beat Sassuolo, who has been very strong this season.

As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. programme.desc: Những câu chuyện này đưa sự sống còn đến cùng cực. Giống như chống lại một con gấu đen trong khi treo lủng lẳng trên vách đá. Hoặc trôi dạt qua vùng nước có nhiều cá mập mà không có gì ngoài một đôi ủng cao su để nổi.

programme.title: HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID S2 EP11
programme.desc: Từ những quy tắc nghiêm ngặt của Hammurabi cho đến con mắt ác độc bí mật, lịch sử đầy rẫy những hành động được thực hiện dưới danh nghĩa trả thù. Chúng tôi khám phá những thế lực đã thúc đẩy các cá nhân tìm cách trả thù.

programme.title: BLOOMBERG THE ASIA TRADE

programme.title: BLOOMBERG: THE CHINA SHOW

programme.title: INSIGHT WITH HASLINDA AMIN
programme.desc: Hướng dẫn chính xác dành cho khán giả tin tức toàn cầu để có được bức tranh hoàn chỉnh về câu chuyện lớn nhất trong ngày, thông qua các cuộc phỏng vấn thăm dò và các cuộc trò chuyện mang nhiều sắc thái.

programme.title: BLOOMBERG HORIZONS MIDDLE EAST
programme.desc: Liên kết các yếu tố thúc đẩy thị trường từ qua đêm ở Hoa Kỳ và khắp châu Á vào ngày giao dịch của khu vực, với phân tích chuyên sâu về các câu chuyện kinh doanh, năng lượng và địa chính trị hàng đầu đang định hình các quyết định.

programme.title: BLOOMBERG DAYBREAK: EUROPE
programme.desc: Trực tiếp từ London, chúng tôi cập nhật cho bạn tin tức thị trường qua đêm từ Hoa Kỳ và Châu Á. Ngoài ra, chúng tôi sẽ cho bạn biết những điều quan trọng đối với các nhà đầu tư ở Châu Âu, cung cấp cho bạn thông tin chi tiết trước khi giao dịch bắt đầu.

programme.title: BLOOMBERG: THE OPENING TRADE
programme.desc: Các nhà khoa học đang phát triển nam châm mạnh để tạo ra các nguồn năng lượng sạch như nhiệt hạch. Nhưng sự thống trị của Trung Quốc trong chuỗi cung ứng nam châm đất hiếm đang đe dọa sự sẵn có của chúng trên toàn cầu.

programme.title: THE PULSE WITH FRANCINE LACQUA
programme.desc: Trò chuyện với những vị khách nổi tiếng tại trung tâm kinh doanh, tài chính và chính trị toàn cầu. Chúng tôi sẽ đi đến bất kỳ nơi nào có câu chuyện, mang đến cho bạn những cuộc phỏng vấn độc quyền và những thông tin nóng hổi về biến động thị trường.

programme.title: BLOOMBERG BRIEF
programme.desc: Cung cấp tin tức, dữ liệu và phân tích thị trường mà bạn cần để thiết lập chương trình làm việc của mình.

programme.title: BLOOMBERG SURVEILLANCE
programme.desc: Cuộc trò chuyện hàng ngày với các nhà lãnh đạo và người ra quyết định từ Phố Wall đến Washington và hơn thế nữa. Được tổ chức bởi Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz và Annmarie Hordern.

programme.title: BLOOMBERG OPEN INTEREST

programme.title: BLOOMBERG TECH
